name: wordpress_blog
covers: WordPress theme: Jetpack share buttons and related posts, comments, sidebar widgets, an email sign-up form and a Complianz cookie banner around the post.
known_issues: The lazy-loaded figure (an SVG data: placeholder in src, the real image in data-lazy-src) is dropped with its caption: trafilatura discards it before clean_html can promote data-lazy-src.

name: substack_post
covers: Substack post: subscribe widgets, like/share buttons, an SVG-laden heading anchor, a captioned image inside <picture>, and a footnote.
known_issues: The image's figcaption is dropped by trafilatura.
The footnote number is left as bare text ('doubled.1', then a line with just '1'): the fragment links don't survive extraction.

name: news_paywall
covers: Paywalled news story: the article body is aria-hidden and inert, interleaved with 'Advertisement' slots, a related-links block and a paywall gateway.
known_issues: The photo is dropped; its caption survives with the credit run into it ('comment.Credit...Marcus Bell').
The 'What happens next' subheading comes out of trafilatura as a plain paragraph.
The 'A version of this article appears in print...' line is kept.

name: jsonld_app_shell
covers: JavaScript app shell whose visible page is a paywall teaser; the full text is only in the schema.org articleBody inside an @graph.
known_issues: trafilatura finds the articleBody itself and returns it as one paragraph, so the json-ld stage (which splits on blank lines) never runs and the reader gets a single wall of text.

name: ghost_tech_post
covers: Ghost post: a code block, inline code, a data table, h1 subheadings inside the content, a captioned image card and a callout card.
known_issues: The tag link ('Engineering') before the title is kept, and because it precedes the title heading, the repeated title isn't removed.
Inline <code> becomes a <pre> block inside the paragraph, splitting the sentence.
The image's caption and the callout card are dropped.

name: medium_post
covers: Medium post: utility-class soup, clap/listen/share buttons, a <picture> with only <source> srcsets and no img src, and 'More from' recommendations.
known_issues: The author's avatar, the byline line ('Sam Adeyemi7 min read·Jan 18, 2026') and the clap count ('2.1K') are kept as article text.
The main figure (srcset only on <source>) is dropped with its caption.

name: wiki_article
covers: MediaWiki page: infobox, table of contents, [edit] section links, citation superscripts, a reference list, a navbox and category links.
known_issues: '[ edit]' is kept after every section heading.
The reference list is dropped, leaving an empty 'References' heading and unlinked [1] markers.
The infobox image is dropped; the infobox itself is kept as a table.

name: magazine_longform
covers: Magazine feature: paragraphs split across 'paywall'-classed containers, a drop-cap lead-in span, an in-content ad, a pull quote, a 'Read more:' link, a newsletter sign-up and a OneTrust cookie banner.
known_issues: The dek (subtitle) and the contributor bio are dropped.

name: email_newsletter
title: The Greenhouse Letter: October
covers: Email newsletter delivered as feed content (not fetched, so only clean_html runs): nested role=presentation layout tables, a hidden preheader, a two-column image/text row, a social-links row and a tracking pixel.
known_issues: 'View in browser', the logo, the 'Share this letter with a friend' button and the unsubscribe footer are kept.

name: wordpress_feed_content
title: Lifting and Storing Dahlias
covers: A WordPress RSS item's content:encoded (not fetched, so only clean_html runs): a lazy-loaded image with a relative data-src, the 'more' marker, Jetpack share buttons and related posts, a '5 min read' line and a stats pixel.
known_issues: Jetpack's related posts ('### Related', 'Planting tulips late') are kept: its class and id are 'jp-relatedposts', which splits into the tokens 'jp' and 'relatedposts', neither of them in JUNK_TOKENS.
The 'The post ... appeared first on ...' line WordPress adds to feeds is kept.
